item.title: 【Interviews / TV shows / Others】HDTV - [Fan-made] Landman - The West Texas Edit (S1 & S2 of 'Landman' re-edited)
item.description:
Presenting: Landman - The West Texas Edit (Seasons 1 and 2 of Landman re-edited)
Editor: Blofeld's Cat (with optical-effect contribution by 'Tremault' from fanedit.org)

Video: 1920p x 1080 / SDR / HEVC
Audio: Dolby Digital 5.1 (English)
Subtitles: English
Total Duration: 407-mins (approx.)
Presentation Format: Episodic (12 episodes)

The evidence of numerous social-media discussions related to seasons 1 and 2 of Landman suggests that a significant percentage of viewers share the opinion that enjoyment of the show was compromised, to varying degrees, by the shenanigans of two characters i.e. Tommy Norris' wife and daughter - Angela and Ainsley respectively; indeed, the story arc's that involved one or both characters had negligible impact upon, or integrated in any meaningful way with, the main storyline involving Tommy Norris and M-Tex Oil.

To maintain a seamless teleplay, cuts, edits, and trims were made at storyline, scene, and dialogue levels.

WHAT CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE? - SEASON 1
REMOVED - All references to both of Ainsley's boyfriends.
REMOVED - Rebecca's dialogue about her vibrator (out of place for the situation in which it was delivered).
REMOVED - Standalone Angela/Ainsley storylines (fitness club, old-folks home, strip-club).
REMOVED - Ainsley-centric conversations between Tommy and Ainsley, Angela and Ainsley, and between Tommy and Angela about Ainsley.
REMOVED - Dialogue of other characters that make reference to the aforementioned Ainsley/Ashley scenarios.
REMOVED - A few inconsequential lines of dialogue from various characters to facilitate smoother video and/or audio edits.
REMOVED - All shots, from general scenes, that conspicuously-reference excised scenes.
TRUNCATED - A few of Cooper & Ariana's 'developing romance' scenes have been trimmed of repeated or redundant dialogue.
TRUNCATED - The indulgently-lengthy monologue of Dallas Cowboys owner, Jerry Jones, has been shortened.
TRUNCATED - Incidence of sexualised behaviour/dialogue of, Ainsley and/or Angela has been reduced.

WHAT CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE? - SEASON 2
REMOVED - All scenes of, and all references to, Ainsley's collegiate shenanigans (including Angela's interference in the same).
REMOVED - The Ariana/Cooper storyline.
REMOVED - All scenes and dialogue references to the assault upon Ariana.
REMOVED - All scenes and dialogue references to Cooper's arrest.
REMOVED - All scenes and dialogue references to a fatal truck/car accident.
REMOVED - All scenes and dialogue references to a fatal gas leak.
TRUNCATED - Interactions between Rebecca and Charlie have been trimmed of ponderous, often repetitive, dialogue.
TRUNCATED - Scenes with (often tiresome, always tawdry) sexually-charged behaviour or dialogue of the Angela character.

CAVEAT(S)
It is a possibility that one or more of the excised storylines - especially those from S2 - might become significant in future seasons of Landman. Should such be the case in subsequent seasons, the Landman - The West Texas Edit will be withdrawn from distribution.
